component.name: Checkbox
component.description: Single checkbox control with card and list variants and custom true/false values.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Labelable checkbox wrapper that coordinates input, indicator, and text content.

slots.name: container
slots.description: Text column that groups label and description.

slots.name: control
slots.description: Visible checkbox control users recognize as the toggle target.

slots.name: indicator
slots.description: Visual checked or indeterminate state layer inside the control.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Check or indeterminate icon rendered for the current state.

slots.name: wrapper
slots.description: Inner layout wrapper used by card and list checkbox variants.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Supporting text associated with the checkbox.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: defaultChecked
own.description: Whether the checkbox is checked by default (uncontrolled).

own.name: falseValue
own.description: Value to use when the checkbox is unchecked.

own.name: formFieldBind
own.description: Whether to bind the checkbox value to the parent FormField.

own.name: id
own.description: The ID of the input element.

own.name: indeterminate
own.description: Whether the checkbox is in an indeterminate state.

own.name: name
own.description: The name of the input element, used for form submission.

own.name: onChange
own.description: Callback when the checked state changes.

own.name: onPointerDown
own.description: Pointer down handler for the checkbox root container.

own.name: trueValue
own.description: Value to use when the checkbox is checked.

own.name: value
own.description: Native value submitted when the checkbox is checked.
